text:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — we’re starting a small interop smoke for v2 this Thursday 09:30 PT. Focus: header negotiation + SDK fallback behavior. Please flag blocking deps by EOD tomorrow.

Dave R: Thanks — can you call out which endpoints we’ll exercise?

Maya Chen: Mainly /v2/generate, /v2/embeddings, and the streaming path. We want simple end-to-end from webapp -> dedicated -> hosted fallback.

Olivia K: I’ll own embeddings path. Question: are we testing both quantized and fp16 model variants?

Maya Chen: Yes — Samir will run quantized on dedicated and we’ll verify fallback to hosted fp16.

Samir Patel: I’ll queue a dedicated slot and run a short throughput test. ETA: Wed afternoon. Need to know expected request shape for embed requests.

Lia (DevEx): Use payload: {"input":"<string>","model":"redwood-embed-v2"} — we have a sample in SDK under examples/embed_quickstart.py.

Dave R: Noted. Any SDK changes required for header negotiation? We have older clients that only send X-Redwood-Version.

Maya Chen: Right — new header is Accept-API-Version: v2. SDK should send both for now: Accept-API-Version + X-Redwood-Version for telemetry parity. We’ll remove X- header in a later minor.

Olivia K: Can we add a tiny check in the JS SDK to detect server-side 426 (Upgrade Required) and auto-retry with Accept-API-Version: v2?

Lia (DevEx): Agree — small retry wrapper is low-risk. Sample pseudo:

```
// on 426 -> set header and retry once
if (res.status === 426) { headers['Accept-API-Version'] = 'v2'; retry(); }
```

Maya Chen: Good. We’ll mark SDK owners to ship a patch today. @Dave R and @Olivia K, please post PR links when ready.

Dave R: Will do. Also pinging infra: any firewall rules that block the Accept-API-Version header?

deploy-bot: FYI — dedicated slot 42 reserved for samir-quant-test from 2026-03-18 15:00 to 16:00 PT.

Samir Patel: Slot confirmed. I’ll attach logs to the ticket: INF-3987.

Olivia K: I noticed during last run some clients got 502 when KV cache warmed. Suggest adding a canary route for a slow ramp.

Maya Chen: Good catch. Plan: ramp 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 30m. Canary route name: v2-smoke-canary.

Lia (DevEx): Also please record token-level latency in the console trace for the canary. We want per-route P95 and tail traces.

Dave R: One more ask: compatibility tests should include proxy header passthrough (edge proxies often strip unknown headers). We should verify Accept-API-Version survives our CDN.

Maya Chen: Copy. Samir, include a simple curl against the edge with header and check response headers. Example test:

```
curl -i -H "Accept-API-Version: v2" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.example/v2/generate
```

Samir Patel: Will do. If the header disappears, fallback will be triggered but we need to know if fallback path is honored.

Olivia K: If the fallback is to hosted, we should ensure no sensitive customer headers leak. Confirming that customer metadata headers are stripped on fallback.

Maya Chen: Security confirmed: the router will not forward X-Customer-* on automatic fallback. I’ll attach the internal design note.

Lia (DevEx): Small coordination item — please add migration owners to the rollout doc: Maya (lead), Dave (SDK), Olivia (embeddings), Samir (dedicated infra), Lia (devex). I’ll update the playbook.

Dave R: PR for SDK header retry incoming in ~2h.

Olivia K: I’ll draft embeddings smoke checklist after Samir’s run.

Samir Patel: Tests scheduled Wed 15:00 PT, will post results + curl traces to INF-3987.

Maya Chen: Thanks all. If anyone hits blockers please @channel here. :thumbsup:
